cc_baseline.sample_unit: one complementary contribution = two utility evaluations
cc_baseline.sampling: j iid uniform on {1,...,n}; coalition iid uniform conditional on size j

configuration.empty_coalition_rule: best constant-label accuracy on the fixed test set
configuration.single_class_rule: predict the coalition's sole observed class

ground_truth.estimator: streaming antithetic permutation Monte Carlo (independent permutation/reverse-permutation pairs)
